q:
Cloze Test (1/5): Select the most appropriate option for Blank No. 1.

'The implementation of AI in healthcare is (1)______ to be a game-changer. It can (2)______ vast amounts of data to provide accurate diagnoses. However, we must remain (3)______ about data privacy. Ethical (4)______ should be prioritized to avoid misuse. A collaborative (5)______ between doctors and developers is essential.'
e: Blank 1: 'Poised' (तैयार/स्थित) का अर्थ है किसी महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार होना।

q: Error Spotting: No sooner (A) / he had arrived (B) / than the (C) / meeting started (D).
e: Inversion Rule: जब वाक्य 'No sooner' से शुरू हो, तो Auxiliary verb (had) subject से पहले आनी चाहिए। सही: 'No sooner had he arrived'।

q: Error Spotting: The reason (A) / for his failure (B) / is because (C) / he did not work hard (D).
e: Redundancy: 'The reason' के साथ 'that' का प्रयोग होता है, 'because' का नहीं क्योंकि दोनों कारण ही बताते हैं।

q: Error Spotting: He is (A) / one of those (B) / people who (C) / is never on time (D).
e: Relative Pronoun Rule: 'Who' यहाँ 'people' (Plural) के लिए आया है, इसलिए verb 'are' होनी चाहिए, न कि 'is'।

q: Error Spotting: Having been (A) / found guilty (B) / on murder (C) / he was sentenced to death (D).
e: Prepositional Error: 'Guilty' के साथ हमेशा 'of' लगता है। सही: 'guilty of murder'।

q: Error Spotting: Not only did (A) / she bake a cake (B) / but also (C) / prepared some snacks (D).
e: Parallelism: 'Not only' के बाद verb (did she bake) है, तो 'but also' के बाद भी 'she prepared' या inversion की संरचना संतुलित होनी चाहिए। 'But also she prepared' सही होगा।

q: Sentence Improvement: If I *had* a million dollars, I would travel the world.
e: Conditional Type 2: 'If + V2 (had), would + V1' काल्पनिक वर्तमान के लिए बिल्कुल सही है।
Perspicacious का अर्थ है बहुत समझदार या सूक्ष्मदर्शी (Insightful/Shrewd)।
Nefarious (अति दुष्ट) का उल्टा 'Virtuous' (सदाचारी/नेक) होता है।

q: Active/Passive: They have already completed the task.
o: The task has already been completed by them
e: Present Perfect 'has/have + V3' बदलकर 'has/have + been + V3' हो जाता है।

q: Direct/Indirect: 'Will you lend me your pen?' she said to me.
o: She asked me if I would lend her my pen
She told me to lend pen
She asked if I will lend
e: Interrogative: 'Will' बदलकर 'would' हो जाता है और 'if/whether' का प्रयोग होता है।
